summary: Critical outage in kafka-orders caused by memory_leak (INC-0055)
description: Service kafka-orders incident INC-0055. Symptoms: container OOMKilled. Error: MemoryError: unable to allocate 128MB array in worker.py:64. Root cause was memory_leak. Followed runbook RB-memory-leak-restart.

comments.author: devops1
comments.body: Restarted service pods for kafka-orders and applied RB-memory-leak-restart.
